# Returns: how to send something back

## What happens next

When the parcel reaches our warehouse in Kochi, we check that the item is unused and has its tags. If it passes, we refund you; see [Refunds: when and where your money goes](refunds). If it doesn't pass, we send it back to you and explain why.

# Returns: how to send something back

## How to start a return

1. Sign in, open **Orders**, choose the order and press **Return an item**. If you checked out as a guest, email support@tidewater.example with your order ID (it looks like TW-10423) and the item you are sending back.
2. Pack the item with its tags, in its original packaging if you still have it.
3. **In India**, pickup is free: a courier collects the parcel from your address within 3 business days. You don't need to print anything.
4. **Outside India**, please send the parcel yourself to the address below with a tracked service. International customers pay the return shipping.

Tidewater Goods Returns
Unit 4, Harbour Road Industrial Estate
Kochi, Kerala 682003, India

# Refunds: when and where your money goes

## When you get your money

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

If you cancelled an order before it was packed, there is nothing to inspect: a prepaid order's refund starts the day you cancel and arrives within 5–7 business days.

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

# Waterproof ratings explained

## Fabric: millimetres of water column

For jackets and tents we give a number in millimetres (mm), also called hydrostatic head. Picture a tall tube standing on the fabric and filling with water: the rating is how high the water can rise before drops come through. 10,000 mm means a column of water 10 metres high.

| Rating | What it handles | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| 1,500 mm | Light drizzle and short showers | None (we don't sell anything below 3,000 mm) |
| 3,000 mm | Steady rain for an hour or two | Tent flysheets (Compact, Solo and Family tents) |
| 5,000 mm | Rain for most of a day | Coastal Light Shell; tent floors |
| 10,000 mm | Heavy rain for hours | Monsoon Rain Jacket |
| 20,000 mm | All-day monsoon downpours, with straps pressing on your shoulders | Storm Pro Jacket |

Why do tent floors need more than flysheets? Kneeling or sitting on a floor pushes water through it, so the floor needs a higher rating than a flysheet that rain only falls on.

# Jacket size guide

## How each jacket fits

| Jacket | SKU | Fit | Sizes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Coastal Light Shell | JKT-COASTAL | Slim: close to the body for walking and cycling | S, M, L, XL |
| Monsoon Rain Jacket | JKT-MONSOON | Regular: room for a T-shirt and a light fleece | S, M, L, XL |
| Storm Pro Jacket | JKT-STORM | Relaxed: room for a warm layer, longer at the back | M, L, XL |

The size goes at the end of the SKU: a medium Monsoon Rain Jacket is JKT-MONSOON-M.

# Jacket size guide

## Still not sure?

- If you are usually an M in T-shirts, you are usually an M in our jackets too.
- The Coastal Light Shell is the snuggest; many people size up in it.
- Email support@tidewater.example with your height and chest measurement and we will suggest a size.

If it doesn't fit, you can return it unused, with its tags, within 30 days of delivery, and order the right size. See [Returns](returns-policy).

# Your data and how long we keep it

## Why

To deliver your orders, handle returns, refunds and warranty claims, answer your questions, and keep the records the law requires. If you agree to it at checkout, we also send you news about sales; every such email has an unsubscribe link.

# Contact us

## Help us help you faster

- Put your **order ID** in the subject (it looks like TW-10423).
- Write from the email address you ordered with. For your privacy, we can only discuss an order with the email address on it.
- For damage, wrong items and warranty claims, attach photos.
- One email per issue is fine; we will reply to all of them.

# Your data and how long we keep it

## How long

| Data | How long we keep it |
|---|---|
| Order and invoice records | 8 years, because tax rules require it |
| Support emails and messages | 2 years after your last message |
| Bank details for a cash-on-delivery refund | 90 days after the refund is paid |
| Your account (name, saved addresses) | Until you ask us to delete it |

# Express delivery

## Changing to express

You can't switch an order to express after you have placed it. If it is still **Placed** (not yet packed), you can cancel it and order again with express; see [Cancelling an order](cancel-order).

# Changing your delivery address

## Before your order is packed

While your order's status is **Placed**, email support@tidewater.example or message us on WhatsApp (+91 90000 01234) with:

- your order ID (it looks like TW-10423),
- the full new address, including the PIN code, and
- a phone number the courier can call.

We confirm by email once it is changed. If the new address is in a different city, the shipping charge may change; express delivery is only available to some cities (see [Express delivery](express-delivery)).

# Express delivery

## If express is late

If your express parcel hasn't arrived within 2 business days of leaving our warehouse, email us with your order ID. We will chase the courier and tell you what happened.

# Ways to pay: UPI, cards, net banking, cash on delivery and EMI

## Invoices

Every order's GST invoice is attached to the shipping email and can be downloaded from **Orders**. To claim GST input credit for a business, enter your GSTIN at checkout; we can't add it to an invoice afterwards.

# Bulk and corporate orders

## How to ask for a quote

Email bulk@tidewater.example with:

- the products and quantities (sizes too, for jackets and sandals),
- the delivery address and the date you need them by, and
- your company's name and GSTIN, if you want a GST invoice for input credit.

We reply with a quote within 2 business days.

# Bulk and corporate orders

## Returns

Unused items without a logo can be returned within 30 days of delivery, like any order. For returns of more than 10 items, please email us first so we can arrange a single pickup.

# Warranty and how to claim

## How to claim

Email support@tidewater.example with:

1. your **order ID** (it looks like TW-10423; it is in your order confirmation email),
2. **photos** of the fault, close up and of the whole item, and
3. a photo of the product label inside the item.

A claim needs the order ID and photos; without them we can't start it. If you have lost the order ID, tell us the email address you ordered with and roughly when.

# Caring for your waterproof backpack

## If something breaks

Seams, zips and buckles that fail in normal use within a year of delivery are covered by the [warranty](warranty-claims).

# Warranty and how to claim

## What the warranty covers

Faults in how the item was made, such as:

- **seams** that come apart or leak along the stitching,
- **zips** that split, lose teeth or stop closing,
- **buckles** and clips that crack or won't lock,
- tent poles or pole sleeves that fail during normal setup.

# Refunds: when and where your money goes

## Where the money goes

Refunds always go back to the way you paid. We can't send them anywhere else, such as a different card, a friend's account or a different UPI ID.

| You paid with | Your refund goes to |
|---|---|
| UPI | The same UPI account |
| Credit or debit card | The same card |
| Net banking | The same bank account |
| EMI | Your credit card; your bank closes the EMI plan |
| Gift card | The gift card's balance |
| Cash on delivery | A bank account you give us; see [Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders](cod-refunds) |

Your bank may take a few extra days to show a card refund on your statement. If 7 business days have passed since we told you the refund was sent, email us with your order ID and we will send you the bank's reference number.
